comment: Authored, never generated. Each record is the accepted byte identity of one frozen release: the release document, the suite manifest it pins, and the schema-case index inside that suite. tools/generate-vectors, tools/validate.py and tools/release_gate.py all hold the checkout to these digests, so a regeneration that rewrites a released suite fails instead of producing a new, internally consistent, silently different release. Changing a digest here is an explicit act that a reviewer sees.
